Game Overview

Agent & the Crook is a casual game built around join Agent in their strategic mission to outsmart cunning crooks planning a bank heist. Draw clever routes to navigate traps, capturing the criminals while collecting treasures. Beware of interconnected paths; use finesse and precision to progress. Vibrant visuals and intuitive controls heighten the thrill of this tactical pursuit.
